name: Shirayukihime
source:
The middle of the three sisters who are members of the religious cult "Taiyou". She is a very kind girl, but due to her slightly timid nature she ends up in getting trouble with the other members of the cult who misunderstand her.

She trusts her older sister [url=/c72279]Thumbelina[/url], but tends to get into fights with her often because of their contrasting personalities and due to Snow White often not knowing what to say in front of Thumbelina without angering her.
